cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(clangsolv VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
find_package(LLVM REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(Clang REQUIRED CONFIG)
# Some Windows LLVM packages export the DIA library's build-machine path.
# Rebind that imported dependency locally; do not edit the installed package.
if(MSVC AND TARGET LLVMDebugInfoPDB)
  get_target_property(csolv_pdb_links LLVMDebugInfoPDB INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
  set(csolv_fixed_pdb_links)
  foreach(link IN LISTS csolv_pdb_links)
    if(link MATCHES "diaguids\\.lib$" AND NOT EXISTS "${link}")
      find_library(CLANGSOLV_DIAGUIDS_LIBRARY NAMES diaguids
        PATHS "${CMAKE_GENERATOR_INSTANCE}/DIA SDK/lib/amd64" REQUIRED)
      set(link "${CLANGSOLV_DIAGUIDS_LIBRARY}")
    endif()
    list(APPEND csolv_fixed_pdb_links "${link}")
  endforeach()
  set_property(TARGET LLVMDebugInfoPDB PROPERTY INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES "${csolv_fixed_pdb_links}")
endif()
if(LLVM_PACKAGE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 18)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "ClangSOLV needs LLVM/Clang 18 or newer; tested with 19.1.0")
endif()
message(STATUS "ClangSOLV: LLVM ${LLVM_PACKAGE_VERSION} from ${LLVM_DIR}")
add_executable(clangsolv checker/main.cpp)
target_compile_features(clangsolv PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
set(CLANGSOLV_RESOURCE_DIR "${LLVM_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib/clang/${LLVM_VERSION_MAJOR}" CACHE PATH "Clang builtin header directory used by the checker")
if(EXISTS "${CLANGSOLV_RESOURCE_DIR}/include")
  target_compile_definitions(clangsolv PRIVATE CLANGSOLV_RESOURCE_DIR="${CLANGSOLV_RESOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
target_include_directories(clangsolv SYSTEM PRIVATE ${LLVM_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${CLANG_INCLUDE_DIRS})
separate_arguments(clangsolv_llvm_definitions NATIVE_COMMAND "${LLVM_DEFINITIONS}")
target_compile_options(clangsolv PRIVATE ${clangsolv_llvm_definitions})
target_link_libraries(clangsolv PRIVATE clangTooling clangFrontend clangAST clangAnalysis clangBasic clangLex LLVMSupport)
if(MSVC)
  # Match the runtime selected by the LLVM development package.
  set_property(TARGET clangsolv PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "${CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY}")
  target_compile_options(clangsolv PRIVATE /bigobj)
endif()
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME clangsolv-regressions COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/test_clangsolv.py" --checker "$<TARGET_FILE:clangsolv>")
